narrative: Lackas increased their output with 22 PRs merged compared to 14 previously, while also seeing a significant rise in median PR size and median cycle time. The substantial growth in code volume and slower review turnaround times point to a shift toward larger, more complex contributions that take longer to merge.
root_cause_hypothesis: The work shifted to much larger items rather than output dropping, leading to increased cycle times.

evidence_chain.claim: Merged PRs increased from the previous period
Median PR size more than doubled
